notes.label: Research cutoff
notes.text: 28 October 2026 — Official websites checked; older pages not presented as current 2027 terms.

notes.label: Scope
notes.text: Sheet 2 CS Field Filter: 34 rows tagged Adjacent tech / quantitative; merge CYBER duplicated entry and QuanTEEM / QuanTEEM plus duplicate course → 32 unique programme rows.

notes.label: Open Oct28–Dec31
notes.text: Confirmed/expected opening dates inside this period are on first worksheet, even if full scholarship unavailable.

notes.label: Priority 1
notes.text: Strong fit for a BS Computer Science graduate with AI engineering, computer vision and research background. Not admission probability.

notes.label: Priority 2
notes.text: Technically adjacent / potentially eligible; verify credits for physics/electronics and concentration.

notes.label: Priority 3
notes.text: Poor academic fit, not funded for 2027, inactive, or uncertain admission.

notes.label: Admission Type
notes.text: Single = one programme/consortium application (even if administrative university enrolment follows). Both for EMJM Imaging may require separate Politecnico di Milano admission in specific tracks.

notes.label: Stipend
notes.text: Standard current funded EMJM maximum is €1,400/month over up to 24 months. Where 2027 funding is unverified this is explicitly conditional, NOT confirmed.

notes.label: IELTS vs MOI
notes.text: Published requirements are programme/country-specific. IMLEX and EMINENT do NOT accept Pakistani MOI alone for 2027; Europhotonics and IFROS do.

notes.label: GRE
notes.text: Not listed means not identified in reviewed admission sources, NOT an ironclad 2027 promise.

notes.label: Pakistan Eligible
notes.text: Nationality eligibility is separate from bachelor subject eligibility. YES can still mean the BSCS transcript lacks required physics/chemistry/agriculture credits.

notes.label: Links
notes.text: Course link = curriculum, eligibility and university admission instructions. Erasmus Apply link = official programme gateway; no central universal Erasmus apply form.

notes.label: Sources
notes.text: Column P contains official site used to verify each programme; programme entries without published 2027 rules are deliberately marked TBA.
